q: 1. The thickness of 25 guage sheet is
explain: 25 Gauge (SWG) steel is approximately 0.508 mm thick, which is significantly less than 1mm.

q: 2. When it is not specified, the number of hold fasts for a door is usually taken as
explain: When not specifically indicated, the standard/default number of hold fasts provided for fixing a door frame is 6 (3 on each jamb).

q: 3. The concealed faces of the frames of doors and windows are painted with
options: two coats of same enamel paint which is applied for the rest of the frame
explain: Faces of timber frames in contact with masonry are coated with coal tar or a wood preservative to prevent moisture penetration and decay.

q: 4. Demolition means
options: breaking up the structure with care
explain: Demolition refers to the systematic destruction of a building where the recovery of materials is not the primary concern.

q: 5. Dismental means
options: breaking up the structure with care
explain: Dismantling implies taking a structure apart carefully so that the components can be salvaged and reused.

q: 6. Specifications for the hold fasts are given in terms of
explain: Hold fasts are specified in terms of their length (e.g., 30 cm, 40 cm hold fast), which determines their embedment and anchoring capacity.

q: 7. The document supplementing the drawing to furnish information that are not covered in drawings and explaining the workmanship, and method of working is
explain: Specifications describe the quality of materials and the standard of workmanship required, which drawings alone cannot convey.

q: 8. Quality of works or materials is mentioned in
explain: Specifications are the document where the required quality of works and materials for each item is explicitly described.

q: 9. In a galvanised corrugated iron sheet the pitch (centre to centre distance) of corrugation is usually
explain: The centre-to-centre distance (pitch) between corrugations in a standard GCI sheet is usually about 75 mm.

q: 10. Besides standard length and width of a corrugated sheet, one important dimension usually considered is
explain: Apart from the standard length and width, the gauge (thickness) of the sheet material is another crucial dimension that determines strength and cost, and is thus specifically considered.

q: 11. Which one of the following is not the standard length of asbestos cement corrugated sheets
explain: Standard AC corrugated sheet lengths are available in specific increments (such as 1.5, 1.75, 1.25 m and others); 2.5 m is not among the standard manufactured lengths.

q: 12. Rivets are specified by
options: type, diameter, length and size of head
type, diameter, length and mode of rivetting
explain: Rivets are conventionally specified by their type and diameter as the essential identifying parameters.

q: 13. Detailed specification specifies the following for a particular item of work in a project?
explain: A detailed specification covers quality/quantity of materials, their proportions, and the method of preparation and execution for each item.

q: 14. Specification of works is required only when the work is carried by:
explain: Specifications are essential for any mode of execution to ensure quality and standard of work.

q: 15. The information which can not be included in drawings is conveyed to the estimator through
explain: Specifications convey descriptive information about quality, materials, and methods that drawings alone cannot express.

q: 16. An explicit set of requirements to be satisfied by a material, product or service is called a set of:
explain: Specifications detail the materials, workmanship, and standards required for the project.

q: 17. The height of the sink of wash basin above floor level is kept
explain: A wash basin is standardly mounted at a height of 75 cm to 80 cm above floor level for comfortable use.

q: 18. The inspection pit or chamber is a manhole provided in a base drainage system
options: at every change of direction and gradient
at the point where vertical soil pipe joins the house drain
explain: Inspection chambers/manholes are provided at every change of direction/gradient, at regular 30 m intervals, and where a vertical soil pipe meets the house drain — all these conditions apply.

q: 19. Specification for the holdfasts are given in terms of
explain: Holdfasts (metal anchors for door/window frames) are specified in terms of their weight, since they are fabricated steel items.

q: 20. In specification of earth work in foundation trenches, drains, etc. specified lead is
explain: The standard free lead specified for earthwork in foundation trenches and drains is 30 m, consistent with the earlier related question.

q: 21. In corrugated Galvanized Iron sheets, the pitch of the corrugation is measured, usually as
explain: The standard pitch for CGI sheets used in roofing is commonly 75mm.

q: 22. The two type of specification commonly are
explain: Specifications usually focus on the materials to be used and the items of work to be performed.

q: 23. The two important types of specification commonly used are
explain: The two important types of specification commonly used in estimation are material specification (properties/quality of materials) and item (detailed/work) specification (method of execution).

q: 24. Which of the following is a type of contract specification:
explain: Technical specifications are the core part of construction contracts, detailing how the work is to be done.

q: 25. The life of paint is assumed to be
explain: For depreciation/valuation purposes, the useful life of paint is conventionally assumed to be about 5 years, after which it needs to be redone.

q: 26. The capacity of a flushing cistern is normally
explain: A conventional flushing cistern used with WCs is normally designed with a capacity of about 30 to 40 litres.

q: 27. The minimum size of the pipe connected to septic tank is
explain: The minimum recommended diameter of the pipe connecting a WC/drain to a septic tank is 150 mm, to prevent blockage from solids.

q: 28. The size of the standard modular brick is
explain: The standard modular brick size (as per IS specifications) is 19 cm × 9 cm × 9 cm, which becomes 20 × 10 × 10 cm when a 1 cm mortar joint is included.
